column1: # Measured tests of the split packages of ci/go_test_splits.tsv (CHAOS-13668): package<TAB>TestName<TAB>seconds. A go-quality test
# leg cuts a split package's names into its parts by these rows (ci/go_race_shard.awk cut()): a measured name longest first onto the
# lightest part, any other name by a hash of its own name, so adding or removing an unmeasured test moves no other test. The plan
# weighs a part by its rows plus an even share of what the rows leave of the package row in ci/go_test_weights.tsv.
# A row is the LARGER of the warm and the cold value (CHAOS-13730). Both are round(W * e/E): e = the test's top-level elapsed (cold: the
# largest elapsed of the test and its subtests, as a parallel subtest's time is not in its parent's line), E = the summed e of the tests
# of one go test of the package in that run, W = that go test's `ok` seconds (warm: the package row of ci/go_test_weights.tsv).
# - warm: the go-test-timings-test-K artifacts (go-quality.yml) of 4 successful go-quality push runs on main at 10 test legs
# - cold: the test legs of go-quality run 6221 (a go.sum change: the test-result cache missed), one go test per split package and leg.
#   TestWorkerSecretKeysGuardsRealTree of internal/cigates/chartgates takes the 572 s its go test measured in test leg 1 of pull request run 43558584492.
# - internal/cigates/testshard and internal/cigates/checkgo (CHAOS-13800): warm from the push runs 43604205978, 43605920383, 43606101382,
#   43615706484 (median over 4); cold from push run 43554424993 (the same go.sum change on main: the test-result cache missed).
# - measured-median raise (CHAOS-13800, 12 test legs): a row more than 10 % under its measured value is raised to it, and a listed test of 2 s
#   or more (warm) or 10 s or more (cold) gets a row. Measured = round(W * e/E) with e the largest elapsed of the test and its subtests in
#   every run, the larger of the median over push runs 43604205978, 43605920383, 43606101382, 43615706484, 43639842320 and the cold push run 43554424993.
#   The checkgo and splitshards tests of test leg 6 of job 132600091336 (pull request run 43644616312) count it as a sixth warm sample.
# - 13 test legs (CHAOS-13800): a row more than 10 % under its measured value is raised to it, and a listed test of 2 s or more (warm) or
#   10 s or more (cold) gets a row. Measured = round(W * e/E), e the largest elapsed of the test and its subtests, the larger of the median
#   over the full push runs after the shared build cache (43615136198, 43615706484, 43619868597, 43639842320, 43659268009) and cold run 43554424993.

# - CHAOS-13953 (internal/cigates/splitshards, 5 parts): median over the warm push runs 43676204152, 44105231987, 44062558493, 43963804592 (round(W*e/E), e the largest elapsed of the test and its subtests, W the leg's go test ok seconds; mean of the middle two); only TestTheAuthAllLegsFormPrintsEachLegsOwnList was more than 10 % under it and is raised, no row is lowered; cold: not measured, no go.sum change since 5 parts.
# Rows: every listed test of 2 s or more warm or 10 s or more cold, and each package's heaviest tests up to its part count (no part can be empty).
# A row must name a test `go test -list` reports: renaming or removing a measured test needs its row edited in the same change
# (the leg and internal/cigates/testshard fail otherwise). Refresh: the same reduction over newer runs; values only cost balance.

# - CHAOS-14341 (both directions): a row whose measured value differs from it by more than 10 % and 2 s or more is set to that value, and a listed test of 2 s or more gets a row; measured = the median of round(W * e/E) (e the largest elapsed of the test and its subtests, W the leg's `ok` seconds) over the go-test-timings-test-K artifacts of the main-push runs of ci/go_test_weights.tsv's CHAOS-14341 line (n >= 5 runs per row). It drops the larger-of-warm-and-cold rule (CHAOS-13730) for these rows: the go.sum-change run 44694742462 measured like warm runs (shared build cache); 377 s of modelled headroom covers a cold run; a cold-cache wall red reruns warm.

# CHAOS-14513: internal/cigates/checkgo, racescope, splitshards and testshard (the packages whose parts chain on test leg 6/13, 815-935 s): a row more than 10 % and 2 s from its measured value, and a test of 2 s or more with no row, is set to round(W*e/E), median over the 5 full push runs 45080177613, 45078564493, 45076738801, 45074535053, 45062145483 (W = the part's `ok` seconds, e = the largest elapsed of the test and its subtests, E = the summed e of the part; 4 or more runs per test).
